question: How should the secondary chronology claim of a 1951-08-18 Shanghai 《文汇报》 publication be reconciled with an official National Library of China scholarly review that bibliographically records Zhao Wanli's article in 《文物参考资料》 1951 no.9 pp.221-233?
answer: The official NLC-hosted scholarly review PDF provides a stronger modern bibliographic control for the 《文物参考资料》 carrier: its PDF page 5 / printed page 10 directly lists Zhao Wanli's 《永乐大典展览的意义——一九五一年八月北京图书馆举办》 in 《文物参考资料》1951年第9期, pp.221-233. This does not resolve first publication. The target review page contains neither 《文汇报》 nor 8月18日, but that omission has no authority to disprove an earlier newspaper appearance. Therefore the project preserves a bibliographic tension rather than selecting a winner: Wenwu issue-9 carrier is HIGH-confidence modern institutional bibliographic control; the 1951-08-18 Shanghai Wenhui claim remains a secondary lead pending direct newspaper-page evidence; Wenhui-to-Wenwu transmission/revision/reprint relation remains unresolved.
